context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about a high-rise incident
purpose: Teach: 落下/最高裁判所/拒絶/探求/力学/神学/高層/個体

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 高層建築での落下事故、最高裁判所まで持ち込まれた事例があります。
lines.en: There have been cases of high-rise fall incidents that went all the way to the Supreme Court.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Opening with slight professional distance. Clear enunciation on factual details. Calm baseline—this is routine briefing, not alarm. Eyes level, posture composed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 当事者の拒絶反応、激しかったんでしょうか。
lines.en: Were the parties involved particularly resistant to legal action?
lines.style: Lean forward slightly with genuine curiosity. Soft opening, building toward the question. Seeking understanding, not challenging. A pause before the final phrase—he's thinking as he speaks.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。力学的な探求と、現場の個体差、両方を考慮します。
lines.en: Yes. We have to account for both the mechanics of the incident and the individual circumstances at the scene.
lines.style: Firm but not clinical. Light emphasis on 「both」—showing the complexity he's aware of. Steady pace. Speaking from actual case experience, not textbook. Slightly warmer than the first line.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 神学的な信仰の議論まで絡んできた事案も?
lines.en: Even cases where theological or faith-based arguments came into play?
lines.style: Genuine surprise coloring the question. Slight rise in pitch at 「theological」. Quick, engaged—he's truly interested now. Respectful tone despite the unusual nature of the question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: まれですが、ありますね。
lines.style: Brief, accepting nod in the voice. Small exhale before speaking. Matter-of-fact—he's seen enough to be unsurprised by human complexity. A touch of quiet knowing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Genuine gratitude. Slight bow in the delivery—respect for the time and honesty given. Warm closing. Brief but sincere, not rushed.
